title: RangeNav: Task-Aligned LiDAR Range-Image Pretraining for Robot Navigation
title_zh: RangeNav：面向机器人导航的任务对齐LiDAR距离图像预训练
abstract: Autonomous mobile robots operating in dense crowds and cluttered sites require $360^\circ$ perception to react to surrounding hazards. While panoramic LiDAR offers full-surround coverage, learning representations within reinforcement learning (RL) is sample-inefficient under sparse rewards, and existing 3D pretrained point-cloud encoders are too memory-heavy for massively parallel RL simulation. We present RangeNav, a compact (183k parameters) LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data. RangeNav uses anisotropic convolutions and circular padding to handle the extreme aspect ratio and azimuthal seam of range images. We pretrain the network using a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) prediction, then freeze it for policy learning. In simulation, adding semantic and BEV supervision increases success rates over a reconstruction-only baseline by an average of 32.03 and 23.73 percentage points (pp) in procedurally generated training and out-of-distribution realistic test environments, respectively. Zero-shot real-world deployments on a Unitree B2-W quadruped demonstrate robust navigation through dense crowds, low-light settings, and construction zones where limited-field-of-view depth policies struggle. Code and models will be open-sourced.
abstract_zh: 在密集人群和杂乱场所中运行的自主移动机器人需要360度感知来应对周围危险。全景LiDAR提供全环绕覆盖，但在稀疏奖励下，强化学习（RL）中的表示学习样本效率低，且现有的3D预训练点云编码器对于大规模并行RL仿真来说内存占用过大。我们提出RangeNav，一个紧凑的（183k参数）LiDAR距离图像编码器，完全在合成数据上预训练。RangeNav使用各向异性卷积和循环填充来处理距离图像的极端长宽比和方位角接缝。我们使用结合距离重建、语义分割和鸟瞰图（BEV）预测的导航对齐目标预训练网络，然后冻结它用于策略学习。在仿真中，添加语义和BEV监督相比仅重建基线，在程序生成的训练和分布外真实测试环境中，成功率平均分别提高32.03和23.73个百分点（pp）。在Unitree B2-W四足机器人上的零样本真实世界部署表明，在密集人群、低光环境和有限视野深度策略难以应对的施工区域中，导航稳健。代码和模型将开源。
tldr_zh: 紧凑LiDAR编码器预训练提升机器人导航成功率。
cover_zh: 仅183k参数！这个LiDAR编码器让四足机器人零样本穿越人群
